text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rhein Kraft was defeated in the Oaks. Yet 
her performance was so fierce that even 
the victor, Cesario, was overwhelmed by 
it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She notices Special Week and the others in 
the stands. The two of them were 
congratulating the victor, Cesario.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rhein Kraft also congratulated Cesario, 
with whom she had fiercely competed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, with a pained expression, Air 
Messiah quickly hurried away from the 
turf...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With winners and losers each holding their 
own emotions close to heart, the curtain 
fell on the Japanese Oaks.
